implemented: One dedicated peer-pinned connection starts only after original owner admission and a joined registration callback. It shares the original owner lifetime and account boundary.

The relay admits only reviewed initialization, exact account/config reads, one exact read-only/on-request resume and exact original-task reads. No unknown method, model turn, login/config mutation or other-task forwarding is permitted.

The same connection checks effective restrictions and original account, brackets resume with fresh account samples, verifies its reply, and withholds acknowledgement until the caller retention callback and delivery complete.
Cancellation and account/task unloading withdraw acknowledgement; stop joins pending registration, protocol and notification callbacks. Process exit remains a separate owner check.
limits: Production durable ingress journal, signed routes and retained Terminal activation remain unfinished. The retention callback in this demonstration is controlled test storage.
